import re


def word_count(text: str) -> int:
    """Return the number of words in text.

    KNOWN BUG: splits only on single spaces, so punctuation attached to
    words inflates counts and consecutive spaces create empty tokens.
    """
    return len(text.split(" "))


def reverse_words(text: str) -> str:
    """Return the text with word order reversed.

    'hello world' -> 'world hello'
    """
    return " ".join(reversed(text.split(" ")))


def capitalize_words(text: str) -> str:
    """Capitalize the first letter of every word.

    """
    return " ".join(w.capitalize() for w in text.split(" "))","lineStart":1,"lineEnd":28,"totalLines":28,"truncated":false}},"title":"textproc.py","time":{"start":1788527135901,"end":1788527135924}},"id":"prt_06c864c91001rssLZW9w13Cc0e","sessionID":"ses_f937b1aa6ffewboe2v5kbVn0nJ","messageID":"msg_06c85786b001RZh1FPzXx5hsgm"}}
